summary: NightFood Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a non-binding LOI to acquire 51% of Jiun Jiang Enterprise via share exchange, with consideration solely in NightFood common stock (final terms to be set). The transaction would make JJ Enterprise a majority-owned subsidiary. No price, premium, or break fee stated; no board recommendation or advisor named. The deal is subject to definitive agreements and closing conditions, with no guarantee of consummation. Watch for definitive agreement and due diligence updates; risk-arb is speculative given non-binding nature.
